svg.title: JavaScript a page downloads, 0.4.x and 0.5
svg.desc: Gzip sizes on one scale. A 0.4.x landing page downloads 215 KB: 77 KB before it shows prices, 32 KB of tracking, and 106 KB of checkout and upsell code preloaded on every page. A 0.5 landing page downloads 31 KB: 26 KB before prices and 5 KB of tracking once the page is idle. A 0.5 checkout page adds its 25 KB checkout chunk, 56 KB in all.
svg.text: JavaScript a page downloads (gzip, one scale)

text.style: fill: var(--clean-fg, #111827); font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

rect.style: fill: var(--color-amber-500, #f59e0b); fill-opacity: 0.45; stroke: var(--color-amber-500, #f59e0b); stroke-width: 1.5
fill: var(--color-amber-500, #f59e0b); fill-opacity: 0.28; stroke: var(--color-amber-500, #f59e0b); stroke-width: 1.5
fill: var(--color-amber-500, #f59e0b); fill-opacity: 0.14; stroke: var(--color-amber-500, #f59e0b); stroke-width: 1.5

svg.text: The 77 KB carried zustand, decimal.js, and the debug overlay's highlight.js and FontAwesome.

text.style: fill: var(--clean-fg, #111827); font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

svg.text: before prices: loader 1 KB + core 25 KB
then tracking, 5 KB, once the page is idle

text.style: fill: var(--clean-fg, #111827); font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

rect.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); fill-opacity: 0.45; stroke: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); stroke-width: 1.5
fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); fill-opacity: 0.3; stroke: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); stroke-width: 1.5
fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); fill-opacity: 0.2; stroke: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); stroke-width: 1.5

svg.text: + the checkout chunk, 25 KB, only with a checkout form
a quarter of what every 0.4.x landing page downloaded
0.4.x measured from its build; 0.5 from npm run build, where each chunk has a size budget.
